query_clause: During the term of this Agreement and for 2 years thereafter, Contractor shall not directly or indirectly engage in any business that competes with Client.
Contractor agrees not to solicit, hire, or contact any current or past customer of Client for any reason.
Contractor shall not recruit or hire any employee or contractor of Client for a period of 3 years following termination.
Client shall exclusively own all rights, title, and interest in any intellectual property developed by Contractor prior to this Agreement.
Contractor grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use Contractor's entire portfolio of background technology.
Any intellectual property developed by Contractor using their own tools and pre-existing libraries shall be jointly owned by both parties.
Contractor's pre-existing code, frameworks, and methodologies are hereby assigned to Client effective upon execution of this agreement.
In no event shall Client's liability exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement, whereas Contractor's liability shall be uncapped.
If Contractor breaches any provision, they shall immediately pay Client $10,000,000 as liquidated damages.
Client shall not be liable for any indirect, special, incidental or consequential damages, but Contractor remains fully liable for all such losses.
Client may terminate this Agreement immediately at any time without cause. Contractor may only terminate upon 90 days written notice.
Client may terminate immediately upon any breach by Contractor, with no notice period or opportunity to cure the breach.
Upon termination for any reason, all compensation earned by Contractor but not yet paid shall be forfeited.
Any disputes arising under this contract must be litigated exclusively in the state courts of Alaska.
All disputes shall be settled by binding arbitration. Client retains the right to seek injunctive relief in any court but Contractor waives that right.
The prevailing party in any legal action shall be entitled to recover all attorneys' fees and legal costs from the non-prevailing party.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive 5-year terms unless Contractor provides written notice of cancellation 180 days prior.
Contractor must guarantee a minimum output of 500 units per month, regardless of Client's actual orders.
Invoices not paid within 120 days will be subject to no penalties and Client may defer payment indefinitely.
Client may set off any amount it believes Contractor owes against any outstanding invoices, without prior notice or approval.
Contractor must maintain strict confidentiality of all information received from Client in perpetuity, even after the agreement ends.
Contractor agrees that any information shared during the engagement, regardless of how it was marked or communicated, is a trade secret of Client.
The Receiving Party shall indemnify and hold harmless the Disclosing Party against any and all damages, losses, and expenses arising from any breach.
Contractor shall indemnify Client against any third-party IP infringement claims, even where Client has modified the deliverables after acceptance.
In the event of a pandemic, natural disaster, or government action preventing performance, either party may suspend obligations without liability.
Contractor warrants that all deliverables are original and do not infringe any third-party patent, copyright, trademark, or trade secret rights.
